note: FC 27 Settings<timestamp> slider map. 2.10 (TEST_31 G-S1, evidence/2026-10-15/g_s1): the Game Settings CUSTOM sliders are a 125-byte u8 block (GameplayTypeCustomData, custom_block: payload 0xB8976 = file 0xB8DDC, element k = setting id 0x8C + k [assessed]); the u32 array (array_base) did NOT move and is NOT what the Custom screen shows: entries get custom_index (byte index in that block) and no u32 index. Only the three observed bytes are verified (user.sprint_speed 0x50, user.acceleration 0x51, cpu.sprint_speed 0x24). That the engine READS this block in a match (G-S2 display, G-S3 effect) is NOT proven; under Authentic the screen shows the preset and a Custom write may change nothing. Every other custom_index is ASSESSED: id and builder index-order derived (docs/re/settings_store_6AC07E31.md section 2), name from the match-copy anchors (sprint 0, acceleration 1, trap error 6, pass speed 13, injury frequency 14 = builder slider index; custom_index = side base + k) - read-only. Entries without custom_index: no derivable slot (name to slot order not known).
